items.title: Ten Years After December 2016: What Became of the New Gambia?
items.summary: Lawyer Abdoulie Fatty By Abdoulie Fatty I remember that Friday afternoon, 2nd December 2016, as vividly as if it were yesterday. I had just taken a shower and was preparing to leave for Jummah prayers. The Adhan could be heard from my house. Then came the announcement by Alieu...
